spec.what: Thirteen Advanced Temporary Fencing hire agreements 36751-36756 and 36758-36764, installed 21 and 22 Oct 2026 (the event week), signed and photographed (Andrew, 23 Oct 2026, the photographs sent without words); recorded through the page's own red-book form (recordHireAgreement) and charged at the 2026 card. Every figure read twice at full size, the hard ones from crops, and by an independent reader, who agreed on every charged figure. CCB event or demarcation from the programme request where there is one (Ocean Ave is Event, EVENT WEEK row 61); the wheels are recorded as components because no paper carries a gate line and vehicle gates are inside the card's metre; mesh fence is recorded clean where the paper writes no bracing metres and no scrim - Advanced's sheet decides the line when it comes.

ops.note: Mesh fence 147.5 m (59 panels), CC barrier 315 m (126 barriers), 8 wheels, 54 bases, 54 clamps. No gate line on the paper: the 8 wheels are recorded as components. Programme EVENT WEEK rows 60-61 (22 Oct): Perimeter Fence - Ocean Ave, 150 m clean with 3 double-wide vehicle gates (3 wheels), and CCB - Ocean Ave, 300 m Event (quantity may reduce - awaiting confirmation), so the CCB is Event. Vehicle gates are inside the card's metre; Advanced's sheet prices the wheels when it comes. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Mesh fence 30 m (12 panels), 19 bases, 19 clamps, 1 brace. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Programme EVENT WEEK row 23 (20 Oct) is Demarcation CCB - Rhapsody, 133 m, a different job; no mesh-fence row for the sales office walk-through. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

CC barrier 10 m (4 barriers) around a fallen tree on Macintosh Island (the site address was overwritten twice, then 'Macintosh Island failen', read as fallen, with 'tree' in the Region box). Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Mesh fence 35 m (14 panels), 24 bases, 24 clamps, 6 braces. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Mesh fence 20 m (8 panels), 9 bases, 10 clamps, 1 brace, crash protection at turns 2-3. Not a named row in the EVENT WEEK programme. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Bracing added to the existing fence at the Triangle: 34 bases, 34 clamps, 17 braces. No metres and no charge line on the paper; components only, as 36597 and 36519 (bracing an existing fence). Advanced's sheet decides whether it bills braced-for-scrim metres. Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan.

Owner/site supervisor signature present, name not written; contact Brendan. Prices and totals blank on the paper.
